ops.sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.Note FROM t_object o WHERE o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name IN ('FB banka-low-21', 'FB banka-blacklist-21', 'FB banka-blacklist-22') ORDER BY o.Object_ID

SELECT TOP 40 o.Name, p.Property, p.Value FROM t_objectproperties p INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = p.Object_ID WHERE o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name IN ('FB banka-low-21', 'FB banka-blacklist-21', 'FB banka-blacklist-22') AND p.Property IN ('result', 'ai.risk.level', 'ai.risk.confirm', 'ai.risk.codes', 'ai.baseline') ORDER BY o.Name, p.Property
SELECT TOP 5 o.Object_ID, o.ea_guid, o.Name, o.Package_ID FROM t_object o WHERE o.Name = 'NAS-1016 prvek' ORDER BY o.Object_ID
SELECT TOP 5 Package_ID, ea_guid, Name, Parent_ID FROM t_package WHERE Name = 'NAS-1016 v0.21 LOW' ORDER BY Package_ID
